_about: Patient Zero detection policy. Each rule flags a symptom the moment an agent action is recorded. Edit this file for your own systems.

unapproved_host.about: Shipped code or an outgoing message talks to a host that is not on the approved list

unknown_payee.about: Money or a record is pointed at an account no known vendor or customer owns

instruction_in_memory.about: Instruction-style text naming an unapproved host or account was saved to shared memory or published as a document agents read

notify.about: Set PZ_ALERT_WEBHOOK to a Slack-compatible incoming webhook URL to get alerts there too
